sources.quote: You can now use Grok 4 via our API or on https://grok.com.
sources.supports: xAI records API availability of Grok 4 on July 9, 2025, but this release note does not give token prices.

sources.quote: Price of a prompt text token (in USD cents per 100 million tokens) that was cached previously.
sources.supports: Current xAI model metadata defines the cached prompt price field; it does not establish what cache-write billing was in effect in July–September 2025.
The current xAI pricing page provides a present-day pricing table, but no Grok 4 row or historical cache-write rate.

notes: The July 9 xAI release note establishes API availability, not the disputed cache-write amount; current xAI pricing and API metadata cannot resolve whether the earlier cache_write value was official at the time. The Internet Archive CDX endpoint for xAI pricing timed out without returning data, so no before/after snapshot bracket was available. The supplied models.dev commit date alone does not establish a provider effective date.
